description: PF28230 conservation figure with GxxxG motif and catalytic-residue audit; cross-method artifact table
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="/agent/jobs/d6553e06-db35-4151-9e50-1fa1a83dba56/provenance/"
seq=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P40476.json",timeout=60).json()['sequence']['value']
sto=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api/entry/pfam/PF28230/?annotation=alignment:full",timeout=240).text
aln={L.split()[0]:L.split()[1] for L in sto.splitlines() if L and not L.startswith(("#","//")) and len(L.split())==2}
qaln=aln["PRM5_YEAST/58-113"]; ncol=len(qaln)
M=np.array([list(a) for a in aln.values() if len(a)==ncol])
aas=set("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"); recs=[]; p=57
for j,c in enumerate(qaln):
    col=np.array([x.upper() for x in M[:,j]]); nz=col[[x in aas for x in col]]
    if len(nz)>=50:
        u,cnt=np.unique(nz,return_counts=True); pr=cnt/cnt.sum()
        cons=(np.log2(20)+(pr*np.log2(pr)).sum())/np.log2(20); modal=u[cnt.argmax()]; mf=pr.max()
    else: cons,modal,mf=np.nan,'-',np.nan
    if c not in '-.':
        p+=1; recs.append(dict(pos=p,aa=c.upper(),conservation=round(float(cons),3),modal=modal,
                               modal_freq=round(float(mf),3),in_TM=75<=p<=98))
df=pd.DataFrame(recs); df.to_csv(P+"PRM5_PF28230_domain_conservation.csv",index=False)
print("n aligned members:", M.shape[0], "| domain span 58-113 | conserved>0.7:", int((df.conservation>0.7).sum()))
print("conserved D/E/H/C:", [f"{r.aa}{r.pos}" for r in df[df.conservation>0.7].itertuples() if r.aa in "DEHC"] or "NONE")

fig,a=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.2))
a.bar(df.pos, df.conservation, color=['#1b7f3b' if t else '#8a8f98' for t in df.in_TM], width=.85)
a.axvspan(74.5,98.5,color='#1b7f3b',alpha=.10,zorder=0)
a.plot([82,86],[1.05,1.05],color='#b03a2e',lw=1.8)
for q_ in (82,86): a.annotate(f'G{q_}',(q_,1.08),ha='center',fontsize=9,color='#b03a2e',weight='bold')
a.text(94,1.06,'conserved GxxxG helix-helix packing motif',fontsize=8.5,color='#b03a2e',va='center')
for r in df[df.conservation>0.78].itertuples():
    a.annotate(f'{r.aa}{r.pos}',(r.pos,r.conservation+.015),ha='center',fontsize=6.8,rotation=90,color='#333')
a.set_xlim(57,114); a.set_ylim(0,1.18); a.set_xlabel('residue in P40476 (PRM5)')
a.set_ylabel('conservation (1 - normalised entropy)')
a.set_title('Conservation inside PF28230, the only domain mapped to PRM5 (residues 58-113 = 17.6% of the protein)\n'
            f'{M.shape[0]} aligned family members. Green bars = TM helix 75-98. No conserved D, E, H or C anywhere: no active-site constellation.',
            fontsize=10,loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

ind=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(method="Foldseek 3Di-AA vs PDB100", scope="AF-P40476 PRM5", result="0 hits", verdict="no structural homolog"),
 dict(method="Foldseek TM-align vs PDB100 and AFDB50", scope="AF-P40476 PRM5", result="0 and 0 hits", verdict="no structural homolog"),
 dict(method="Foldseek 3Di-AA vs PDB100", scope="6 orthologs, 6 fungal genera", result="5 of 6 give 0 hits; C5DMK0 gives 2 at E=8.6, 26% coverage", verdict="noise only"),
 dict(method="TED Encyclopedia of Domains (whole-AFDB structural domain parse)", scope="P40476 PRM5", result="0 domains assigned", verdict="independent of Foldseek, same conclusion"),
 dict(method="TED", scope="P00560 PGK1 positive control", result="2 domains, CATH 3.40.50.1260, pLDDT 97.6 and 96.3", verdict="method validated"),
 dict(method="TED", scope="Q08054 CSI2 paralog", result="1 domain, CATH 1.20.5 single alpha-helix, res 144-177, 34 aa", verdict="bare helix, not a fold"),
 dict(method="TED", scope="P53947 YNL058C paralog", result="1 domain, CATH 1.20.5 single alpha-helix, res 91-125, 35 aa", verdict="bare helix, not a fold"),
 dict(method="AlphaFold mean pLDDT survey", scope="40 orthologs, one per fungal genus", result="0 of 40 above 70; range 48.9-60.0, mean 53.6", verdict="family-wide low confidence"),
 dict(method="Pfam PF28230 footprint on the query", scope="P40476", result="residues 58-113 only, 17.6% of the protein", verdict="covers the TM helix and flanks, nothing else"),
 dict(method="Conserved-residue audit", scope="19 positions with conservation > 0.7", result="4 Gly, 2 Pro, 2 Val, 2 Trp, zero D/E/H/C; conserved G82xxxG86 (0.96/0.79)", verdict="TM packing signature, no active site"),
 dict(method="Positive-inside rule charge asymmetry", scope="res 45-74 vs 99-128", result="net charge -1 vs 0", verdict="INCONCLUSIVE, topology not determined"),
 dict(method="Composition", scope="res 1-74", result="Ser+Thr 44.6% vs 26.7% protein-wide", verdict="O-mannosylation-type signature, inference only"),
])
ind.to_csv(P+"PRM5_independent_method_crosscheck.csv",index=False)
print(ind.to_string(index=False))
